sentences.zh: 这是我们作为孩子的环境以及我们的教养和成长环境对一些非常重要的人生决策产生重大影响的关键方式。

sentences.en: What we see will affect what we expect from our own relationships and it can influence our actions, you know, years down the line, ages into the future
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的会影响我们对自己关系的期望，并可能在多年后、在未来的岁月里影响我们的行为，

sentences.en: because our experiences in our upbringing, what we observe, what we expect is going to influence how we perceive romantic love and choose a partner.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在成长过程中的经历、我们观察到的、我们所期望的，将会影响我们如何看待浪漫爱情以及如何选择伴侣。

sentences.en: So there are two theories around the impact of our parents on the partners we choose.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于父母对我们选择伴侣的影响，有两种理论。

sentences.en: The first is that we tend to choose partners and relationships that satisfy something we didn't have as a child, which sounds like a good thing, right?
sentences.zh: 第一种是，我们倾向于选择那些能满足我们童年时期缺失的某种东西的伴侣，这听起来是件好事，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, when we're able to recognize, you know, like I didn't have security and consistency as a child because my parent was uninvolved or neglectful,
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们能够意识到，比如，我童年时因为父母不参与或忽视而缺乏安全感和一致性，

sentences.en: we'll seek out a partner that treats us that way.
sentences.zh: 我们就会去寻找一个那样对待我们的伴侣。

sentences.en: But often when what sometimes psychologists and therapists see is when someone obtains that, it's really hard for them to let that go and they can become
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，心理学家和治疗师有时会看到，当某人获得了那种东西时，他们真的很难放手，他们可能会变得

sentences.en: hyper-dependent on that person because they've kind of given them everything they never had.
sentences.zh: 对那个人过度依赖，因为他们给了他们从未拥有过的一切。

sentences.en: The other kind of theory is that we choose partners that mimic the relationships that we have with our caregivers.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，我们选择的伴侣会模仿我们与照料者之间的关系。

sentences.en: So if we had a narcissistic parent who we always had to impress, whose love was conditional on our successes and our accolades and the compliments and
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们有一个自恋型的父母，我们总是需要去取悦他们，他们的爱取决于我们的成功、我们的荣誉，以及我们对他们的赞美

sentences.en: admiration we had for them, if we had parents who required a lot of praise and didn't have much empathy for our feelings, this might be what we seek in a romantic partner.
sentences.zh: 和钦佩，如果我们有需要大量赞美且对我们的感受缺乏同理心的父母，这可能就是我们在浪漫伴侣身上所寻求的。

sentences.en: And the toxic relationship that we have with our parents evolves into a toxic romantic relationship in adulthood.
sentences.zh: 而我们与父母之间的这种有毒关系，就会演变成成年后有毒的浪漫关系。

sentences.en: Obviously, this is not always the case and it also doesn't have to be.
sentences.zh: 显然，情况并非总是如此，也不必非得如此。

sentences.en: The long-term impacts of toxic and narcissistic family and parenting environments can be mitigated and can be avoided.
sentences.zh: 有毒和自恋型家庭及教养环境带来的长期影响是可以减轻和避免的。

sentences.en: The parents we have are not the only determinants of the lives that we will lead.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的父母并不是我们未来人生的唯一决定因素。

sentences.en: You know, the saying goes, it takes a village.
sentences.zh: 你知道，俗话说，养育孩子需要全村人的努力。

sentences.en: And that definitely applies in this situation.
sentences.zh: 这在当前的情况下绝对适用。

sentences.en: The love we receive from other family members, like a grandparent or an aunt or an uncle, from our teachers, from our mentors, from our friends, the support,
sentences.zh: 我们从其他家庭成员那里获得的爱，比如祖父母、阿姨或叔叔，从我们的老师、导师、朋友那里获得的爱，以及来自

sentences.en: from our community, the validation from activities beyond our families, like school or sports or church, if you attend, all of these can mitigate and
sentences.zh: 社区的支持，来自家庭以外活动（如学校、体育或教会，如果你参加的话）的认可，所有这些都可以减轻并

sentences.en: protect us against the negative consequences of growing up with the toxic or narcissistic parent.
sentences.zh: 保护我们免受在有毒或自恋型父母身边成长所带来的负面后果。

sentences.en: And we also have a choice in many ways in determining the habits and the decisions that can bring us comfort and can allow us to heal.
sentences.zh: 而且在决定那些能带给我们安慰并允许我们疗愈的习惯和决策方面，我们也在许多方面拥有选择权。

sentences.en: So I want to talk through some things that you can do if you've experienced this kind of upbringing or you've suffered through narcissistic parental abuse to overcome this
sentences.zh: 所以我想谈谈如果你经历过这种成长环境，或者遭受过自恋型父母的虐待，你可以做些什么来克服这种

sentences.en: situation, to kind of move past the experiences of your childhood.
sentences.zh: 处境，从而走出童年的经历。

sentences.en: Firstly, it's important to mourn what you didn't have.
sentences.zh: 首先，哀悼你所缺失的东西是很重要的。

sentences.en: Sometimes we actually need to sit in the grief and sit in the resentment and the emotion that we have for a little while before we can move forward.
sentences.zh: 有时我们确实需要沉浸在悲伤、怨恨和情绪中一段时间，然后才能继续前行。

sentences.en: If we don't take time in early adulthood to really recognize the feelings we have towards our parents, the resentment, the blame, the guilt, even sometimes that we have, it just
sentences.zh: 如果我们不在成年早期花时间去真正认识我们对父母的感受——那些怨恨、指责，甚至有时产生的内疚感——它最终只会

sentences.en: ends up being suppressed.
sentences.zh: 被压抑。

sentences.en: And with suppression, there's a lack of recognition.
sentences.zh: 而伴随着压抑，就会缺乏认知。

sentences.en: You're not able to work on something or fix something that you can't acknowledge or understand yourself.
sentences.zh: 你无法处理或修复你无法承认或理解的东西。

sentences.en: So it is important to mourn what you didn't have.
sentences.zh: 所以哀悼你所缺失的东西是很重要的。

sentences.en: It's important to sit with the grief of the what ifs, the grief of the other possibilities
sentences.zh: 重要的是要面对那些“如果当初”的悲伤，面对其他可能性的悲伤，

sentences.en: and hopefully kind of come to terms with the fact that this happened, this was your experience, but it doesn't mean that you can't live a really happy and quality life.
sentences.zh: 并希望能够接受这样一个事实：这件事发生了，这是你的经历，但这并不意味着你不能过上真正幸福和高质量的生活。

sentences.en: The other just essential, essential feature of moving towards a healthy relationship with a parent who may have treated you this way, if
sentences.zh: 另一个与可能这样对待你的父母建立健康关系的关键要素，如果

sentences.en: that's something you want, is to set boundaries.
sentences.zh: 这是你想要的，那就是设定界限。

sentences.en: You know, you might benefit from some distance between you and a narcissistic or toxic parent.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能需要与自恋或有毒的父母保持一定的距离。

sentences.en: You might want to ensure that you establish your non-negotiables.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要确保建立你的“不可逾越的底线”。

sentences.en: You know, if your parent is constantly picking on you or saying things that make you uncomfortable, you're an adult.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你的父母不断地挑剔你，或者说些让你不舒服的话，你已经是成年人了。

sentences.en: You know, as part of it as it is because of that controlling environment they may have built when you're a child, you don't have to put up with that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管这部分是因为他们可能在你童年时期建立的那种控制性环境，但你不必忍受这些。

sentences.en: You don't have to depend on them anymore for their support.
sentences.zh: 你不再需要依赖他们的支持。

sentences.en: So set up non-negotiables, things that you won't tolerate from your family.
sentences.zh: 所以设定一些不可逾越的底线，即你不会容忍家人的某些行为。

sentences.en: You know, maybe you won't tolerate them showing up unexpectedly or visiting you or making unsolicited comments or judgments about your life choices.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许你不会容忍他们不请自来、突然造访，或者对你的人生选择发表未经请求的评论或评判。

sentences.en: You can also ask that they don't have input into your life choices that, you know, there's sometimes there are these crossroads, right, where we can
sentences.zh: 你也可以要求他们不要干涉你的人生选择，你知道，有时会出现这些十字路口，对吧，我们可以

sentences.en: choose whether we want to borrow further into familial and parental control or forge our own path.
sentences.zh: 选择是继续钻进家庭和父母的控制中，还是开辟自己的道路。

sentences.en: Often a narcissistic parent might attempt to kind of keep us in their control and complying through financial support and financial assistance, through
sentences.zh: 通常，自恋型父母可能会试图通过经济支持和援助、通过

sentences.en: gifts, through manipulation and gaslighting.
sentences.zh: 礼物、通过操纵和煤气灯效应，让我们保持在他们的控制和顺从之下。

sentences.en: So do some of that work with a therapist or with a professional to identify what habits and what patterns of behaviour your parent often does to get you back in,
sentences.zh: 所以，与治疗师或专业人士一起做些工作，找出你的父母经常使用哪些习惯和行为模式来让你回到他们的控制中，

sentences.en: to bring you back into the fold and write them down.
sentences.zh: 把你拉回他们的圈子，并把它们写下来。

sentences.en: Make sure you recognise them and you identify what it is about those behaviours that A, makes you uncomfortable, that B, is quite manipulative and which C, can be avoided
sentences.zh: 确保你认出它们，并识别出这些行为中哪些是A让你感到不舒服的，哪些是B相当具有操纵性的，以及哪些是C可以避免的，

sentences.en: and which you can set up boundaries to prevent from happening because you do have to essentially, and as hard as it is, take some kind of ownership to protect your own peace.
sentences.zh: 并且你可以设定界限来防止它们发生，因为你确实必须——尽管这很难——承担起保护自己内心平静的责任。

sentences.en: The other thing we've talked about here that definitely needs addressing is the role of generational trauma that goes back decades and centuries
sentences.zh: 我们在这里谈到的另一件绝对需要解决的事情是代际创伤的作用，它追溯到几十年前、几个世纪前

sentences.en: and generations in kind of determining how a parent chooses to raise their child or often doesn't even choose to raise their child.
sentences.zh: 以及几代人，在某种程度上决定了父母选择如何抚养孩子，或者往往根本没有选择如何抚养孩子。

sentences.en: It's something that's unconscious, right?
sentences.zh: 这是无意识的，对吧？

sentences.en: They don't necessarily choose to harm the children they bring into the world.
sentences.zh: 他们并不一定选择伤害他们带到这个世界上的孩子。

sentences.en: They don't choose to be narcissistic.
sentences.zh: 他们并不选择成为自恋者。

sentences.en: They don't choose to be neglectful or uninvolved.
sentences.zh: 他们并不选择成为忽视者或不参与者。

sentences.en: So sometimes we owe it to ourselves to, you know, work on ending the cycle of intergenerational trauma and intergenerational habits and learning, even if we don't
sentences.zh: 所以有时我们有义务去努力终结代际创伤和代际习惯与学习的循环，即使我们并不

sentences.en: plan on having kids ourselves.
sentences.zh: 打算自己生孩子。

sentences.en: You know, the relationship we have with our caregivers, with our family, with our parents
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们与照料者、家人、父母之间的关系

sentences.en: impacts all other relationships, especially those we may have with our own kids.
sentences.zh: 会影响所有其他关系，尤其是我们与自己孩子之间可能拥有的关系。

sentences.en: And if you don't have, you know, if you don't plan on having kids in the future, the people that we choose to nurture and bring into our lives.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有，你知道，如果你不打算在未来生孩子，那么就是我们选择去培养和带入我们生活中的人。

sentences.en: So I think it's important that once you've identified that this is a cycle that, you know, you've kind of been brought into,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为重要的是，一旦你意识到这是一个你被卷入其中的循环，

sentences.en: you somewhat have a duty to put a stop to it and to
sentences.zh: 你就有某种义务去阻止它，并

sentences.en: address the trauma and the significant things that have happened in your past that your parents and your caregivers may not have had the bandwidth or the resources or the energy
sentences.zh: 解决过去发生的创伤和重大事件，而你的父母和照料者可能没有能力、资源或精力

sentences.en: to deal with.
sentences.zh: 去处理这些问题。

sentences.en: I think it's important that if you've gone through this experience, if you can identify or relate to anything we've talked about today, you discuss that, the impact
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是，如果你经历过这种体验，如果你能认同或联想到我们今天谈论的任何内容，请与你信任的人、爱你的人讨论这些影响，

sentences.en: of that with people that you trust, people that love you, and you identify and relate to what your inner child, your younger self missed out on or would have wanted from a
sentences.zh: 并识别出你内心的孩子、你年轻时的自己错过了什么，或者曾经希望从父母那里得到什么，

sentences.en: parent and emulate that and how you treat the people you care about, how you treat the people that you nurture in your lives.
sentences.zh: 并在你对待你在乎的人、对待你在生活中培养的人时，去效仿这些。

sentences.en: Create an environment and create relationships that make you feel safe.
sentences.zh: 创造一个让你感到安全的环境，建立让你感到安全的关系。

sentences.en: You know, it's all about you now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在一切都取决于你自己了。

sentences.en: You are allowed to be selfish and you're allowed to put yourself first, even if your parents and your family don't see it that way.
sentences.zh: 你可以自私一点，你可以把自己放在第一位，即使你的父母和家人不这么认为。

sentences.en: And talk to a professional who can give you advice and address any of the long-term psychological and emotional harms or insecurities that this upbringing may have caused.
sentences.zh: 并与专业人士交谈，他们可以为你提供建议，并解决这种成长经历可能造成的任何长期心理和情感伤害或不安全感。

sentences.en: Finally, it might sound controversial, but it's important, I think, to forgive.
sentences.zh: 最后，这听起来可能很有争议，但我认为宽恕是很重要的。

sentences.en: Now, I know in instances of abuse, that is a lot easier said than done.
sentences.zh: 我知道，在虐待的情况下，说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: And you don't always have to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且你不一定要这样做。

sentences.en: You know, if this is not something for you, if you don't think you can forgive, if it's going to take too much mental energy, that is totally fine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果这不适合你，如果你觉得你无法宽恕，如果这会消耗太多的心理能量，那完全没问题。

sentences.en: You are allowed to be selfish and you're allowed to choose what you want to do with your life and make the decisions that are most appropriate for you.
sentences.zh: 你可以自私一点，你可以选择你想如何生活，并做出最适合你的决定。

sentences.en: But I think remember that you're not forgiving your parents or these people as a favour or an act of kindness to them or so that they can live their lives guilt-free.
sentences.zh: 但我认为请记住，你宽恕你的父母或这些人，并不是作为一种恩惠或善举，也不是为了让他们可以毫无愧疚地生活。

sentences.en: You're forgiving these people for yourself so that you can be released from a cycle of shame and trauma and move forward without as much resentment and emotional baggage.
sentences.zh: 你宽恕这些人是为了你自己，这样你才能从羞耻和创伤的循环中解脱出来，在没有那么多怨恨和情感包袱的情况下继续前行。

sentences.en: So forgive, but don't forget.
sentences.zh: 所以，宽恕，但不要忘记。

sentences.en: If you related to any of this today, I don't want to say I'm sorry because I don't want to, you know, make you feel like you're being pitied, but I do
sentences.zh: 如果你今天对这些内容有共鸣，我不想说抱歉，因为我不想让你觉得你在被同情，但我确实

sentences.en: want to say you are incredibly strong.
sentences.zh: 想说你非常坚强。

sentences.en: And I'm proud of you for listening to this episode and getting to know more about some of the psychology behind why, you know, if you've had a
sentences.zh: 我很为你感到骄傲，因为你听了这一集，并更多地了解了背后的一些心理学知识，你知道，如果你曾有过

sentences.en: narcissistic or a toxic parent, why they may have acted this way, why their behaviour may have been this way.
sentences.zh: 自恋或有毒的父母，为什么他们可能会有这样的行为，为什么他们的行为可能是这样的。

sentences.en: And I think it's important knowledge and an important kind of understanding to bring into the holiday season as we feel pressure to see our
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种重要的知识，也是一种重要的理解，可以带入到节日季中，因为当我们感到有压力去见我们的

sentences.en: families, to reconnect, to spend time with them.
sentences.zh: 家人、重新建立联系、与他们共度时光时。

sentences.en: And if you've gone through the process of establishing boundaries for the right reasons and for reasons that you think are fair, make sure you stick to them, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你已经经历了为了正确的理由和为了你认为公平的理由而设定界限的过程，请确保你坚持下去，对吧？

sentences.en: Like these parents and these people, as we've described, have many ways of leveraging their role as our parent and their role as kind of the mature, superior person in the
sentences.zh: 就像我们描述的那样，这些父母和这些人有很多方法可以利用他们作为我们父母的角色，以及他们作为关系中

sentences.en: relationship to their advantage.
sentences.zh: 成熟、优越一方的角色来为自己谋利。

sentences.en: So I think it's an important reminder around the holiday season that you're allowed to be selfish and do what's best for you if you've found yourself in this environment.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在节日季这是一个重要的提醒：如果你发现自己处于这种环境中，你可以自私一点，做对自己最有利的事情。

sentences.en: I also want to say thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 我也想说非常感谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: If you're still here, if you're still with me, thank you for supporting the show.
sentences.zh: 如果你还在听，如果你还和我在一起，感谢你对节目的支持。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to another episode.
sentences.zh: 感谢你收听这一集。

sentences.en: It was so great to have you along for the ride to learn some more about this concept and experience and these feelings and realisations that we have in our twenties.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能加入这段旅程，去了解更多关于这个概念、经历，以及我们在二十多岁时所拥有的这些感受和领悟。

sentences.en: If you feel called to do so, if this episode benefited you in any way, please feel free to leave a five-star review on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, wherever you're listening right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，如果这一集对你有任何帮助，请随时在Spotify、Apple Podcasts或你现在收听的任何平台上留下五星好评。

sentences.en: It really helps the show to grow and to reach new people.
sentences.zh: 这真的有助于节目的成长并触达更多的人。

sentences.en: And thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you again.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢。

sentences.en: I feel so blessed to have people who want to listen to this content and want to hear about these topics.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常幸运，有这么多人愿意收听这些内容，愿意了解这些话题。

sentences.en: I think they are so important and so fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们非常重要且引人入胜。

sentences.en: So thank you for coming on board for the ride and I will see you next week for another episode of The Psychology of Your Twenties.
sentences.zh: 所以感谢你们加入这段旅程，下周我会在《二十多岁的心理学》的下一集中见到你们。
